Font registration with optional user paths and a system default.

nvg ships no fonts, so ogimage accepts optional fontTitlePath/fontBodyPath and otherwise searches well-known system locations plus OGIMAGE_FONT_TITLE/OGIMAGE_FONT. Tests and examples should pass explicit .ttf paths to stay deterministic across machines.

Register paths as fallback faces for the current state, so glyphs missing from the title/body font (e.g. Hebrew alongside Roboto) still shape. Unknown files are skipped.
